summary: TipKit is a contextual-tip framework: tip content, display rules, a persistent datastore, inline and popover views, and test hooks. BifrOSt has no tip concept, no tip datastore and no display rules. It has the building blocks a popover tip would need (a transient popover placed next to an anchor, a per-app persistent defaults store, a headless test window), but none of them is tied to tips.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 2 (tipkit, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No tip type, and no code or docs mention tips. The Help menu exists at springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs:119 but holds no tip content.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 2 (tipkit, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No rule engine that counts events or parameter changes to decide when a hint is eligible.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/tips.rs (TipView, TipViewStyle); wired: springboard/ui/src/tips.rs (TipView, TipViewStyle::Mini) via springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs; wired: springboard/apps/reminders-desktop/src/app.rs (AlertHint, TipView, TipViewStyle::Mini); view.rs (draw_tip); main.rs (tip_store)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 6 (b07, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No inline tip container or style hook. Grouped cards exist in widgets.rs but nothing is a tip. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

Popover placement below, above, left and right of an anchor, with a flip when a side has no room and clamping on screen, has headless tests (a_popover_goes_below_its_anchor_when_there_is_room, a_popover_flips_to_the_opposite_edge_when_the_preferred_side_has_no_room, a_popover_on_the_right_edge_opens_to_the_left, a_popover_stays_on_screen). There is no tip content, no action callback and no anchor modifier on SDK views, so an app wires the popover to its anchor by hand.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 2 (tipkit, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No ordered or first-eligible presentation of several hints.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs (per-app typed preferences written to <app data>/defaults.txt)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. Per-app persistent typed key-value storage exists, so tip state could be stored there. There is no configure call, no display frequency limit and no tip-specific store.

features.bifrost: none in the SDK; cloud sync for accounts and backups is in ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud
features.note: CloudKit is an Apple-only service. Tip state would need its own sync path if it were wanted.

features.apple: No TipKit symbol. Tooltips are an AppKit behaviour (NSView.toolTip), not part of TipKit.
features.note: The ToolTip material exists with its window-model kind and six-point blur (the_tool_tip_material_is_listed_maps_to_its_window_model_kind_and_blurs_six_points). docs/bifrost-ui.md says menu items have no tooltips, and no control shows a tooltip on hover.

features.apple: TipUIView, TipUIPopoverViewController, TipUICollectionViewCell, TipUICollectionReusableView, TipNSView, TipNSPopover
features.bifrost: none (BifrOSt apps are Rust with the bifrost_app SDK, not UIKit or AppKit)
features.note: Platform bindings. The popover concept is covered by the popover tip row.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 2 (tipkit, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The headless test window can drive any view, but there is no tip registry to force-show or reset.

gaps: No tip type, no tip content and no display rules (Tip, Rule, Parameter, Event).
No persistent tip datastore with display frequency limits, and no configure call.
No inline tip view or tip view style.
No anchor modifier that presents a tip popover from an SDK view; the popover exists only as a low-level helper.
No testing hooks to show, hide or reset tips.
No tooltips on hover in controls or menus (docs/bifrost-ui.md:362).
